tool_input.description: T1 integration battery progress, failures, and completion
tool_input.command:
LOG=/Users/vladmihaimiron/Documents/DebateAIRO/dialectical-engine/docs/missions/2026-08-17-accounts-privacy-security/logs/T1-rework1-resume1-integration-battery.log
DONE=/tmp/t1r1s1/integration.done
RPID=$(cat /tmp/t1r1s1/runner.pid)
last=0
while true; do
  if [ -f "$DONE" ]; then
    echo "BATTERY ENDED exit=$(cat $DONE) pass=$(grep -c '^ ✓ ' $LOG) fail=$(grep -cE '^ (×|✗) ' $LOG)"
    grep -E '^ *(Test Files|Tests|Duration) ' "$LOG" || true
    break
  fi
  if ! kill -0 "$RPID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "RUNNER PID $RPID GONE without DONE sentinel — battery died unexpectedly. pass=$(grep -c '^ ✓ ' $LOG)"
    break
  fi
  f=$(grep -cE '^ (×|✗) ' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$f" -gt 0 ]; then echo "FAILURE DETECTED ($f failing) — $(grep -E '^ (×|✗) ' $LOG | tail -1)"; fi
  p=$(grep -c '^ ✓ ' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$p" -ge $((last + 8)) ]; then echo "progress: $p/56 tests passed, $(( $(date +%s) - $(grep START_EPOCH $LOG | cut -d= -f2) ))s elapsed"; last=$p; fi
  sleep 20
done

tool_input.description: T1 integration battery progress, failures, completion
